achievement.446.description: [EN] You asked Captain Charles to take a shortcut quite a few times. Now you are all too familiar with desert islands all over Tibia.
achievement.446.name: [EN] High and Dry
achievement.447.description: [EN] Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
achievement.447.name: [EN] Elven Woods
achievement.448.description: [EN] Ancient battlefields, amazons and the glory of Carlin - you really know every corner of Queen Eloise's realm now.
achievement.448.name: [EN] Long Live the Queen
achievement.449.description: [EN] Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
achievement.449.name: [EN] Stronghold of Edron
achievement.45.description: Du elsker å spille vitser på andre og lure dem til å se litt dumme ut. Logrende tunger sier at øyeblikket av erkjennelse i dine ofres øyne er belønningen du lever av, men du tuller nok bare og har det gøy med dem... ikke sant??
achievement.45.name: [EN] Perfect Fool
achievement.450.description: [EN] Vast mines, an orc fortress and the magnificence of Kazordoon - you really know every corner of North-Eastern Mainland now.
achievement.450.name: [EN] Dwarven Mines
achievement.451.description: [EN] Old temples, a meadowy countryside and the splendour of Thais - you really know every corner of King Tibianus' realm now.
achievement.451.name: [EN] All Hail the King
achievement.452.description: [EN] Damp swamps, a dry desert and the opulence of Venore - you really know every corner of Eastern Mainland now.
achievement.452.name: [EN] Jewel in the Swamp
achievement.453.description: [EN] A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
achievement.453.name: [EN] The Ogre Steppe
achievement.454.description: [EN] Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
achievement.454.name: [EN] Realms of Dreams
achievement.455.description: [EN] You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
achievement.455.name: [EN] Mummy's Dearest
achievement.456.description: [EN] You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert.
achievement.456.name: [EN] Daraman's Footsteps
achievement.457.description: [EN] You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
achievement.457.name: [EN] King of the Jungle
achievement.458.description: [EN] You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
achievement.458.name: [EN] Ancient Splendor
achievement.459.description: [EN] A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
achievement.459.name: [EN] Liberty Bay Watch
achievement.46.description: Noen ganger kan livets største hemmeligheter ha en enkel løsning.
achievement.46.name: [EN] Mathemagician
achievement.460.description: [EN] You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
achievement.460.name: [EN] Race to the Pole
achievement.461.description: [EN] From the southern steppe through the Dragonblaze Mountains and the Muggy Plains to the forbidden city of Razachai - you really know every corner of Zao now.
achievement.461.name: [EN] Lizard Kingdom
achievement.462.description: [EN] Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
achievement.462.name: [EN] Trip to the Beach
achievement.463.description: [EN] Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
achievement.463.name: [EN] Glooth Punk
achievement.464.description: [EN] A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
achievement.464.name: [EN] Twisted Dreams
achievement.465.description: [EN] Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight off the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
achievement.465.name: [EN] Library Liberator
achievement.466.description: [EN] You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
achievement.466.name: [EN] Spectulation
achievement.467.description: [EN] You defeated Grand Master Oberon and the remnants of the Order of the Falcon, no matter the odds.
achievement.467.name: [EN] Millennial Falcon
achievement.468.description: [EN] You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
achievement.468.name: [EN] Bibliomaniac
achievement.469.description: [EN] Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
achievement.469.name: [EN] Battle Mage
achievement.47.description: Å levere brev og pakker har alltid vært en hemmelig lidenskap for deg, og nå kan du offisielt ta på deg den blå hatten, blåse i posthornet og gjøre det du liker best. Pass på hunder!
achievement.47.name: [EN] Archpostman
achievement.470.description: [EN] As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
achievement.470.name: [EN] Widely Travelled
achievement.471.description: [EN] You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
achievement.471.name: [EN] Running the Rift
achievement.473.description: [EN] Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
achievement.473.name: [EN] Exalted Battle Mage
achievement.474.description: [EN] Wisely contributing your resources to areas, you pushed creatures to maximum effect, allowing improved respawn for everyone! Well done!
achievement.474.name: [EN] Areas of Effect
achievement.475.description: [EN] You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
achievement.475.name: [EN] Tied the Knot
achievement.476.description: [EN] You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
achievement.476.name: [EN] Keeper of the 7 Keys
achievement.477.description: [EN] You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
achievement.477.name: [EN] Dream Warrior
achievement.478.description: [EN] Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
achievement.478.name: [EN] Moth Whisperer
achievement.479.description: [EN] You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
achievement.479.name: [EN] Lacewing Catcher
achievement.48.description: Du tror ikke på at romantikk er en tilfeldighet eller på kjærlighet ved første blikk. Faktisk - kjærlighetsdrikker, buketter med blomster og cheesy dikt gjør susen mye bedre enn noen gang kunne. Hold disse hormonene flytende!
achievement.48.name: Matchmaker
achievement.480.description: [EN] This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
achievement.480.name: [EN] No Horse Open Sleigh
achievement.481.description: [EN] But can you truly be one of them?
achievement.481.name: [EN] Raider in the Dark
achievement.482.description: [EN] You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
achievement.482.name: [EN] Dream Catcher
achievement.483.description: [EN] You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Summer Court.
achievement.483.name: [EN] Champion of Summer
achievement.484.description: [EN] You have vanquished numerous arena champions in the name of the Winter Court.
achievement.484.name: [EN] Champion of Winter
achievement.486.description: [EN] You literally put everything in that cauldron except lilac and gooseberries.
achievement.486.name: Bewitcher
achievement.487.description: [EN] Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
achievement.487.name: [EN] Gryphon Rider
achievement.488.description: [EN] Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
achievement.488.name: [EN] Sculptor Apprentice
achievement.489.description: [EN] You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
achievement.489.name: [EN] Sun and Sea
achievement.49.description: Du er en av de få tibianerne som Armenius valgte å faktisk vise sitt sanne ansikt til - og han fikk deg til å kjempe mot ham. Enten betyr det at du er veldig heldig eller veldig uheldig, men én ting er sikkert - det er ekstremt sjeldent.
achievement.49.name: Hans sanne ansikt
achievement.490.description: [EN] You ended the regn of Scarlett Etzel. All-seeing yet blind, ever powerful yet ultimately helpless, she never got a second chance to truly see. Or has she...
achievement.490.name: [EN] A Study in Scarlett
achievement.491.description: [EN] What draws things to other dimensions, one wonders. You read the almanac at just the right spot to end up... where, of all places? That is the problem with dimensional travel: you will never know. Or you have always known. And everything in between.
achievement.491.name: [EN] Avid Spectral Reader
achievement.492.description: [EN] You did the hippo population of Kilmaresh a great favour. A well-fed hippo is a happy hippo.
achievement.492.name: [EN] Hippofoddermus
achievement.493.description: [EN] You defeated the Lich Knights and became the hand of the Inquisition, allowed to wear their special garb.
achievement.493.name: [EN] Inquisition's Hand
achievement.494.description: [EN] Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
achievement.494.name: [EN] The Empire's Glory
achievement.495.description: [EN] Your special garb, solely awarded to a dedicated Hand of the Inquisition, is now complete.
achievement.495.name: [EN] Inquisition's Arm
achievement.496.description: [EN] You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
achievement.496.name: [EN] Traditionalist
achievement.497.description: [EN] Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
achievement.497.name: [EN] Do a Barrel Roll!
achievement.499.description: [EN] The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
achievement.499.name: [EN] Orcsoberfest Welcome
achievement.5.description: Enkle skinker og brød får deg bare til å le. Du er mester i det ekstraordinære, smelter av ost, frityrkoker av flaggermusvinger og shaker av shakes. Nydelig!
achievement.5.name: Kulinarisk mester
achievement.50.description: Folk med skarpe hjørnetenner bør passe seg for deg, spesielt om natten, ellers kan de finne en stake mellom ribbeina. Du er en nådeløs vampyrjeger og har samlet en rekke tokens som bevis.
achievement.50.name: Razing!
achievement.500.description: [EN] You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.
achievement.500.name: Prospectre
achievement.501.description: [EN] You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
achievement.501.name: [EN] Nothing but Hot Air
achievement.502.name: Verminbane
achievement.503.description: [EN] Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
achievement.503.name: [EN] Monsterhunter
achievement.504.description: [EN] Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
achievement.504.name: Taskmaster
achievement.505.description: [EN] Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
achievement.505.name: [EN] Mainstreet Nightmare
achievement.506.description: [EN] A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
achievement.506.name: Falconer
achievement.507.description: [EN] Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
achievement.507.name: [EN] Steppe Elegance
achievement.508.description: [EN] Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
achievement.508.name: Beyonder
achievement.51.description: Å rane, invitere deg selv til VIP-fester, forfalske kontrakter og utgi deg for å være noen andre – du er en knallmann når det kommer til ulovlige aktiviteter. Du tar ingen fanger, bortsett fra en og annen gullfisk nå og da.
achievement.51.name: Mestertyven
achievement.510.description: [EN] If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
achievement.510.name: [EN] Drama in Darama
achievement.511.description: [EN] Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.
achievement.511.name: Malefitz
achievement.512.description: [EN] You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
achievement.512.name: Lionheart
achievement.513.description: [EN] Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.513.name: [EN] Soul Mender
achievement.514.description: [EN] Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
achievement.514.name: [EN] You Got Horse Power
achievement.515.description: [EN] You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
achievement.515.name: [EN] Unleash the Beast
achievement.516.description: [EN] You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
achievement.516.name: [EN] Well Roared, Lion!
achievement.518.description: [EN] When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
achievement.518.name: [EN] Honorary Rascoohan
achievement.519.description: [EN] Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
achievement.519.name: [EN] Release the Kraken
achievement.52.description: Du var med på å bringe Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness og Lucky the Wonder Dog til live - og vil sannsynligvis drømme om dem i natt, siden du memorerte replikkene dine perfekt. For et .. spesielt stykke... manus.
achievement.52.name: Amatør skuespiller
achievement.521.description: [EN] You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
achievement.521.name: Pied Piper
achievement.522.description: [EN] You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
achievement.522.name: Woodcarver
achievement.523.description: [EN] Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
achievement.523.name: [EN] Bounacean Chivalry
achievement.524.description: [EN] Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
achievement.524.name: [EN] Knowledge Raider
achievement.525.description: [EN] It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
achievement.525.name: [EN] Citizen of Issavi
achievement.526.description: [EN] Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
achievement.526.name: [EN] King's Council
achievement.527.description: [EN] Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
achievement.527.name: [EN] Hot on the Trail
achievement.528.description: [EN] Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
achievement.528.name: [EN] Shell We Take a Ride
achievement.529.description: [EN] This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
achievement.529.name: [EN] Phantastic!
achievement.53.description: Du slukker Ildåndens flammer i arenaen til Svargrond. Arenakamper er for deg - rettferdige, firkantede, med enkle regler og en-mot-en-kamper.
achievement.53.name: Scrapper
achievement.530.description: [EN] You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
achievement.530.name: [EN] Some Like It Hot
achievement.531.description: [EN] Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
achievement.531.name: [EN] First Achievement
achievement.532.description: [EN] Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
achievement.532.name: [EN] Sharp Dressed
achievement.533.description: [EN] This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
achievement.533.name: [EN] Engine Driver
achievement.534.description: [EN] You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
achievement.534.name: [EN] Friendly Fire
achievement.535.description: [EN] Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
achievement.535.name: [EN] Wedding Planner
achievement.536.description: [EN] You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
achievement.536.name: [EN] Beaver Away
achievement.537.description: [EN] Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
achievement.537.name: Snake Pit
achievement.538.description: [EN] For some it can't be hazardous enough.
achievement.538.name: [EN] Royalty of Hazard
achievement.539.description: [EN] Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
achievement.539.name: [EN] Measuring the World
achievement.54.description: Du utslettet Orcus den grusomme i Arena of Svargrond. Du er fortsatt litt grønn bak ørene, men det er et stort potensiale.
achievement.54.name: Greenhorn
achievement.540.description: [EN] Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your Ripptor.
achievement.540.name: [EN] Ripp-Ripp Hooray!
achievement.541.description: [EN] Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
achievement.541.name: [EN] Warrior of the Iks
achievement.542.description: [EN] You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
achievement.542.name: Mutagenius
achievement.543.description: [EN] Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
achievement.543.name: [EN] Strangest Thing
achievement.544.description: [EN] You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
achievement.544.name: [EN] Fully Decayed
achievement.545.description: [EN] Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
achievement.545.name: [EN] Like Fox and Mouse
achievement.546.description: [EN] Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
achievement.546.name: [EN] The Spirit of Purity
achievement.547.description: [EN] You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
achievement.547.name: [EN] Museum Goer
achievement.548.description: [EN] Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
achievement.548.name: [EN] Mystic Predator
achievement.549.description: [EN] You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
achievement.549.name: [EN] The Rule of Raccool
achievement.55.description: Du sendte Obliverator inn i glemselen i arenaen til Svargrond og beseiret ni andre farlige fiender på veien. Alle hyll krigsherren av Svargrond!
achievement.55.name: Krigsherre i Svargrond
achievement.56.description: Du er en av de modige heltene til å møte og beseire den mystiske demoneiken og alle skapningene den kastet i ansiktet ditt. Å bære din velsignede øks tør ingen tre stå i veien for deg - demonisk eller ikke.
achievement.56.name: Herbicide
achievement.57.description: Du har vågalt hoppet inn i den beryktede Annihilator og overlevd – og tatt med deg berømmelse, ære og belønning hjem.
achievement.57.name: [EN] Annihilator
achievement.58.description: Du var i stand til å kjempe deg gjennom de utallige hordene i Demon Forge. Nok en gang beviste du at ingenting er umulig.
achievement.58.name: Mesteren av Nexus
achievement.59.description: Du er en herre eller dame av dansen - og ikke redd for å bruke ferdighetene dine til å imponere stammeguder. Ett skritt til venstre, ett hopp til høyre, vri og rop!
achievement.59.name: Talentfull danser
achievement.6.description: Du fant hundre vakre perler i store skjell. Nå skal det kjedet være ferdig - og forhåpentligvis fikk du ikke klemt fingrene for ofte under prosessen.
achievement.6.name: Skjellsøker
achievement.60.description: Med et helt ufarlig smil lurte du alle de morsomme gutta til å spise de eksploderende kjeksene dine. Neste gang du drar denne spøken, bør du vurdere å bruke et speiderantrekk for å gjøre det enda bedre.
achievement.60.name: Vil du tillate informasjonskapsler?
achievement.61.description: Du har berørt alle troner i de hensynsløse syv og absorbert noe av deres onde ånd. Det kan ha forandret deg for alltid.
achievement.61.name: Hensynsløs
achievement.62.description: Du vant den nådeløse 2 mot 2 lagturneringen på Isle of Strife og utslettet bølge etter bølge av fryktinngytende motstandere. Død eller seier - du valgte absolutt det siste.
achievement.62.name: Champion av Chazorai
achievement.63.name: Wayfarer
achievement.64.description: En ting er sikkert: Du elsker definitivt å svømme. Å henge på stranden med vennene dine, ha is og spille badeball er sprutende gøy!
achievement.64.name: Waverider
achievement.65.description: Musikk kommer bare til deg naturlig. Du føler deg komfortabel på hvilken som helst scene, når som helst, og håper i all hemmelighet at du en dag vil være i stand til å beseire fiendene dine bare ved å spille musikk. Rock på!
achievement.65.name: Rockstar
achievement.66.description: Du har absolutt dine måter når det gjelder å skaffe penger. Mange av dem er rosa og brolagt med ødelagte fragmenter av porselen.
achievement.66.name: Godtgjørelsesinnkrever
achievement.67.description: Brisen i håret, fingrene dine griper om kanten av teppet ditt - det er slik du liker å reise. Raskere! Høyere! Og en looping nå og da.
achievement.67.name: High-Flyer
achievement.68.description: Du elsker å få hendene våte og skitne – og dekket med leire. Din perfekte skulptur av Brog, den rasende Titan er ditt sanne mesterverk.
achievement.68.name: [EN] Clay Fighter
achievement.69.description: Du vet sannsynligvis ikke lenger hvordan du egentlig ser ut - vanligvis når du ser deg inn i et speil, stirrer et slags monster tilbake på deg. På den annen side – kanskje det er en forbedring?
achievement.69.name: [EN] Masquerader
achievement.7.description: Hvis noen mistet en tilfeldig ting på et tilfeldig sted, er du sannsynligvis en god person til å spørre og finne den, selv om du ikke vet hva og hvor.
achievement.7.name: Ryggsekk turist
achievement.70.description: Under havet - er kanskje ikke ditt naturlige oppholdsrom, men du føler deg ganske komfortabel på havbunnen. Quara skremmer deg ikke lenger, og noen ganger sover du med dypets hjelm fortsatt utstyrt.
achievement.70.name: Dyphavsdykker
achievement.71.description: Å løpe barbeint over glør er ikke noe for deg! Du gjør det på den elegante måten. Likevel er du på en måte tiltrukket av ild og varme omgivelser generelt - du liker det varmt!
achievement.71.name: Firewalker
achievement.72.description: Ah, lukten av hav! Å stå ved kysten og kaste line er en av favorittaktivitetene dine. For deg er fiske avslappende - og samtidig gi enkel mat. Perfekt!
achievement.72.name: Her, Fishy Fishy!
achievement.73.description: Hvis noen gir deg frø, vokser du vanligvis en vakker plante fra den i løpet av få dager. Du liker huset ditt grønt og dekorert med blomster. Du snakker sikkert med dem også.
achievement.73.name: Grønn tommel
achievement.74.description: Din lokale tryllehandler anser deg som en av de beste kundene hans - du kjøper vanligvis store beholdninger av eliksirer slik at du ikke våkner midt på natten og har lyst på mer. Likevel ser du alltid ut til å gå tom for dem for fort. Skål!
achievement.74.name: Drikkavhengig
achievement.75.description: Du elsker å henge i kalde omgivelser og anser is som det beste materialet for å formes. For bortkastet å bruke isbiter til drinker når du kan lage en vakker mammutstatue av den!
achievement.75.name: Isskulptør
achievement.76.description: Hjemmet ditt er ditt slott – og møblene i det er like viktige. Vennene dine spør om råd når de dekorerer husene sine, og du eier sannsynligvis hver statue, stativ og seng som finnes.
achievement.76.name: Interiørdekoratør
achievement.77.description: Noen ganger føler du at det er en gremlin der inne. Så mange lodd, så mange tomme? Det er bare ikke rettferdig! Del elendigheten din med verden.
achievement.77.name: Jinx
achievement.78.description: Det er nesten for mye flaks for én person. Hvis noe er virkelig, virkelig sjeldent - faller det sannsynligvis i fanget ditt før eller siden. Gratulerer!
achievement.78.name: Heldig djevel
achievement.79.description: Du er en aspirerende marmorskulptør med lovende ferdigheter – bevist av den perfekte lille Tibiasula-statuen du formet. En dag vil du bli virkelig berømt!
achievement.79.name: Marblelous
achievement.8.description: Du bryr deg ikke om regler som andre setter opp og former verden etter din smak. Etter å ha etterlatt meningsløse konvensjoner og moral, setter du pris på bare den makten du har. Du er en mester i din skjebne og kjemper for å rense verden.
achievement.8.name: Frykt Herre
achievement.80.description: Herregud, det er en paaaaaaaaaaaarty! Du er alltid ute etter moro, venner og sprit og elsker å være sentrum for oppmerksomheten. Det er uendelige grunner til å feire! Woohoo!
achievement.80.name: Festdyr
achievement.81.description: Du elsker øyeblikket rett før raketten din tar av og eksploderer i vakre farger – ikke bare på nyttårsaften!
achievement.81.name: Fyrverkeri i himmelen
achievement.82.description: Det... er... rett og slett... nei... bedre... måte - enn å reise på ryggen til en skilpadde. Du får i det minste nyte de vakre omgivelsene i Laguna.
achievement.82.name: Rask som en skilpadde
achievement.83.description: Hvis du ser en rusten gjenstand, kan du ikke motstå å polere den. Det er alltid en liten flaske med rustfjerner i inventaret ditt – hvem vet, det kan være en gyllen rustning under all den skitten!
achievement.83.name: Polermaskin
achievement.84.description: Du har sannsynligvis aldri blitt sjøsyk i livet ditt - du elsker å tilbringe fritiden din på havet og tilbakelagt ganske mange mil med skip. Er du ikke glad for at du ikke trengte å svømme alt dette?
achievement.84.name: Skipets Kobold
achievement.85.description: Å reise med dvergdampbåtene gjennom de underjordiske elvene er din foretrukne måte å krysse landene på. Ingen irriterende måker, og godt øl om bord!
achievement.85.name: [EN] Steampunked
achievement.86.description: Er du ikke bare perfekt, fantastisk, vakkert nydelig? Du kan ikke passere et speil uten å beundre utseendet ditt. Eller kanskje ta en rask sjekk om noe sitter fast i tennene dine?
achievement.86.name: Forfengelighet
achievement.87.description: Spåkoner og horoskoper guider deg gjennom livet ditt. Og du ville sannsynligvis ikke våget å gå på storviltjakt uten at din trofaste voodoo-hodeskalle gir deg hans godkjenning for dagen.
achievement.87.name: Overtroisk
achievement.88.description: Du tjente Yalahar - men du virket ikke så sikker på hvem du skulle tro på veien. Både Azerus og Palimuth hadde gode grunner for sine handlinger, og dermed fulgte du mageinstinktet ditt til slutt, selv om du hjalp noen av dem. Måtte Yalahar blomstre!
achievement.88.name: Turncoat
achievement.89.description: Dine små statuer av Tibiasula har blitt ganske kjent rundt Tibia, og det er få mennesker med lignende ferdigheter når det gjelder å forme marmor.
achievement.89.name: Marmorgalskap
achievement.9.description: Du beviste deg selv – ikke bare i drømmene dine – og har et sterkt og åndelig sinn. Din tapre kamp mot demoner og den vandøde pesten har gitt deg den høyeste og mest respekterte rangeringen blant Nightmare Knights.
achievement.9.name: [EN] Lord Protector
achievement.90.description: Sculpting Brog, den rasende Titan, er din hemmelige lidenskap. Tallrike perfekte små leirstatuer med navnet ditt på kan bli funnet overalt rundt Tibia.
achievement.90.name: [EN] Clay to Fame
achievement.91.description: Ta en isbit og en obsidiankniv, og du vil sannsynligvis forme noe veldig pent av det. Stort sett søte små mammuter, som er en hit hos alle jentene.
achievement.91.name: Kaldt som is
achievement.92.description: Du elsker fisk – men helst de som er fanget i det kalde nord. Selv om de er vanskelige å få tak i, blir du aldri lei av å plukke hull i isdekkene og henge fiskestanga i.
achievement.92.name: Utsøkt smak
achievement.93.description: Når det kommer til interrasiell forståelse, er du en ekspert. Du har mestret språket til Chakoya og gjort noen virkelig glade med generøsiteten din. Achuq!
achievement.93.name: Jamjam
achievement.94.description: Din verden er heldig som har deg! Du nøl ikke med å hoppe inn og hjelpe når modige helter blir kalt til å redde verden.
achievement.94.name: Jeg gjorde min del
achievement.95.description: Du er i frontlinjen når det gjelder å redde verden eller delta i sosiale arrangementer. Enten du gjør det lagt merke til eller ubemerket av folket, kan din verden stole på at du pliktoppfyllende gjør din del for å gjøre det til et bedre sted for alle.
achievement.95.name: Beryktet Worldsaver
achievement.96.description: Du anser deg ikke for god til å gjøre det skitne arbeidet mens noen andre kan vinne laurbærene for å ha drept Devovorga. De kunne ikke gjort det uten deg!
achievement.96.name: Lagspiller
achievement.97.description: Du har gått inn i hulen til Devovorga og sluttet deg til mannskapet som prøver å ta henne ned - om det er kronet med suksess eller ikke spiller ingen rolle, men de kan ikke klandre deg for ikke å prøve!
achievement.97.name: vågal overtreder
achievement.98.description: Sjel er som sommerfugler. Den svarte sjelen til et levende våpen som lengter etter å slå, ligger knust under føttene dine.
achievement.98.name: [EN] Slayer of Anmothra
achievement.99.description: Makten ligger i viljen til hun som befaler den. Du kjempet mot det med full kraft – og var sterkere.
achievement.99.name: [EN] Slayer of Chikhaton
